Technical Procedure
Introduction

This document outlines the maintenance procedure P3,
which must be performed after summation of short circuit current
 > 500 ka as indicated in the 
title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Anter Aly Bakr, 
accepted by general director: eng. Ibrahem M. Sayed El Ahl at Awlad Hmam 
220kv substation, and approved by eng. Abdel Rahem Abdel Rahem 
Abdel Rahem; EHV Network Head Sector, Delta zone.
Safety Precautions

items: A work permit must be issued,

The qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc

Circuit 
breaker isolation and earthing is required

Change remet local control switch to local 
position

Separote rebilling volve from volt a geand close 
shut off valve (371 / 372) fig 3

Vent the air from compressed air receiver via drain 
screw (314) or valve (319) fig 3

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check 
 adjustment and function of compressed air pressure switch 376F4 Fig. 2, 
 Adjustment work on the pressure switches must be carried out only by AEG-TFK 
 staff

items:
Check SF6 pressure on 
 manometer. (8 bar at 20 oC, rated pressure=7bar))

Check compressed air manometer 
 with control instrument.

Check air pressure on 
 manometer. 
 (20 bar)

Check SF6 manometer with 
 control instrument.

Check setting and 
 function of manometer contacts. 
 SF6 contact manometer, temperature-compensated 
 F1 density controllere
 K1: SF6-warning, 1st stage pe = 
 7.0 bar (p1)
 K2: SF6-operation, blocking 1 
 pe = 6.5 bar (p2)
 K3:
 SF6-operation, blocking 2 
 pe = 6.5 bar (p2)

Check SF6 moisture content 
 (desired level <20oC).

Check SF6 air content (desired 
 level <2%).

Check SF6 acid content (desired 
 level <5-10 ppmg ).

Check 
 adjustment and function of compressed air pressure switch 376F4 Fig. 2, 
 Adjustment work on the pressure switches must be carried out only by AEG-TFK 
 staff

Check fixed main contact and if 
 necessary replace. 1) 2)

Check movable main contact and 
 necessary replace.. 1) 2)

Check insulating nozzle and if 
 necessary replace. 1) 
 2)

Carry out test switching 
 operations, (before switching check SF6 pressure in the pole columns, and 
 the pressure of air in the compressed air receiver of the breaker):
 - 10 C-O-switching at one minute intervals.
 - Including 2 O-switching with the manual emergency valve.

sections.text: Remarks

1) Requiring opening of gas 
compartment

2) Random checks on circuit 
breaker with max operating duty, further checks only on negative result.
